sources.entry: Insomnia - Insomnia is a cross-platform REST client, built on top of Electron.

summary.one_liner: Insomnia is an open-source, cross-platform API client for GraphQL, REST, WebSockets, SSE, gRPC and other HTTP-compatible protocols.
summary.what_it_does: The README describes Insomnia as a desktop API client covering debugging, designing, testing and mocking APIs. It includes a native OpenAPI editor with visual preview, test suites and a collection runner, and a CLI (Inso) for linting and testing in CI/CD pipelines. Projects can be stored in a Local Vault, in any third-party Git repository via Git Sync, or in the cloud via Cloud Sync, optionally end-to-end encrypted. A local Scratch Pad works without an account, and Private Environments keeps environment config local. The README also mentions a Plugin Hub for third-party plugins and a cloud or self-hosted mocking server.
use_cases: run API test suites in CI/CD
mock an API for frontend work
share API collections with a team
keep API projects in a private Git repo
notable: Supports GraphQL, REST, WebSockets, SSE and gRPC in one client
Storage choice per project: Local Vault, Git Sync, or Cloud Sync (optionally E2EE)
Native Inso CLI for linting and testing in pipelines
Scratch Pad mode works without an account
caveats: Most capabilities require a free account; premium features need paid subscription plans
Git Sync and unlimited collaboration are premium features
Linux and Windows dev setup may need extra system packages or build tools
